name: BIOS / POST / Text-mode
summary: Award BIOS blue POST screen, VGA 16-color attributes, IBM 3270 mainframe fields, and DOS shell chrome — a hardware text-mode aesthetic.
whenToUse: When the user asks for BIOS, POST screen, DOS, text-mode, VGA/CGA, 3270 mainframe, or a hardware-boot/console aesthetic.
rules: Inverse video is a first-class token: every color attribute ships with a swapped background/foreground pair, and selection, hover, focus, and active states are always rendered as that inverse — never as a tint, overlay, or alpha wash.
Boxes are drawn with CP437 glyphs (╔ ═ ╗ ║ ╚ ╝) inside a <pre> at line-height:1; no CSS border, no border-radius, no inset/outset bevel, no gradient depth anywhere.
De-emphasize with the palette, never with opacity: VGA dark gray #555555 or 3270 dim #005a5a replaces any rgba() or opacity:0.5 fade, because alpha produces colors outside the 16-color set.

Font-size must stay an integer multiple of the 16px cell (16px, 32px, 48px); scale the whole terminal with transform:scale on a fixed-cell container and keep image-rendering:pixelated — never a fractional size like 14px or 1.2rem.

Motion is steps() only: blinking block cursor, character-by-character print, and the 0000→N KB memory counter step at discrete values with 0ms/300ms/1200ms durations — no easing, no linear interpolation, no tweened color.

Hot-keys are highlighted glyphs, not badges: the trigger letter inside a menubar label is drawn in #fc5454 (or #fcfc54 on blue), and the bottom strip lists 1Help 2Menu 3Save … 10Quit with each numeral in reverse video.

Every screen carries chrome: a header line (product name, version, date, or 3270 panel id) and a footer/OIA line (instruction, status, row/column indicator, PF-key legend) — a bare content area is not a screen.
Stay inside the palette: derive any new color from vga16, paletteVariants.post, dosShell, or ibm3270 rather than mixing a modern hex; backgrounds are solid attribute fills, never blended.

componentRecipes.panel: background:#0000aa; color:#a8a8a8; font:16px/16px 'Web437 IBM VGA 9x16',monospace; padding:16px; frame it in a <pre> at line-height:1 using ╔═╗║╚╝ drawn in #a8a8a8; the title sits in the top frame line as reverse video: background:#a8a8a8;color:#0000aa; text ' SYS CONFIG ' with one space of padding each side; no border property, no radius, no shadow.
componentRecipes.button: height:32px (two 16px cells); background:#0000aa; color:#a8a8a8; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:0 8px; font:16px/16px mono; text-transform:uppercase; the trigger letter is a separate span in #fc5454; hover and active are inverse video (background:#a8a8a8;color:#0000aa); focus prefixes a solid one-cell block █ in #fcfc54; state changes land in 0ms, never transitioned.
componentRecipes.input: The field is CP437 cells, not a CSS box: render in <pre> at line-height:1 as 'NAME....: [ value______ ]' with background:#0000a8, label in #a8a8a8, entered value in #fcfc54; the caret is a one-cell solid block █ with animation:steps(2,jump-none) 1s infinite; invalid input keeps the value in #fc5454 and appends ' << INVALID'; the active field runs a reverse-video band behind the value and no underline or outline exists.
componentRecipes.statusbar: A fixed footer strip exactly 16px tall: background:#a8a8a8; color:#0000a8; font:16px/16px mono; padding:0 4px; items separated by two spaces — '1Help  2Menu  3Save  4Load  10Quit' with each numeral in reverse video (#0000aa on #a8a8a8); on the 3270 variant swap to an OIA line: background:#000000; color:#00d4d4; 'X SYSTEM  SYS1  READY  24/80' with the X in #ff3030.
componentRecipes.menu: A horizontal menubar of reverse-video words: background:#a8a8a8; color:#0000aa; font:16px/16px mono; padding:0 4px; each label prefixes its trigger glyph in #fc5454 ('F'ile, 'O'ptions); the active item flips back to background:#0000aa;color:#fcfc54; its dropdown is a single-line-double CP437 frame at line-height:1 with exactly one row in inverse video, no shadow, no radius, no open/close animation beyond 0ms.

copywriting.voice: Machine-issued and terse. The system reports state in present tense, names the device or subsystem, and stops — no greeting, no apology, no marketing adjective, no second-person chit-chat. A technician reading under time pressure should get the fact from the first five words.

do: Pair every color with its inverse and use inversion for selection, hover, focus, and active states — a highlighted row is always fg/bg swapped, never a lighter shade.
Draw frames and dividers with CP437 glyphs in a <pre> at line-height:1 so the box characters join without gaps at every size.
Keep every font-size at 16px or a whole multiple, and scale the terminal container with transform:scale plus image-rendering:pixelated to support small and large displays.
Animate only in steps(): blink the block cursor at steps(2,jump-none) 1s infinite, print text character by character, count memory up from 0000 to N KB.
Carry chrome on every screen — a header line with product/version/date or panel id, and a footer line of instructions, status, and the 1Help … 10Quit strip.
Show hot-keys as highlighted glyphs: red trigger letter in the menubar, reverse-video numeral in the function-key strip, matching underlines off.
dont: Don't add border-radius, box-shadow bevels, inset highlights, or gradient depth — cells are flat attribute fills, and the only shadow in the system is the hard offset 10px 10px 0 #000000 for detached black boxes.
Don't de-emphasize with opacity, rgba(), or filter:grayscale — reach for #555555 or #005a5a, which are real entries in the color set.
Don't use CSS borders, `border:1px solid`, or SVG strokes to build a box when the frame should be ╔═╗║╚╝ glyphs.
Don't animate with ease, ease-in-out, cubic-bezier, or transitions — a tweened intermediate color cannot exist in 16 colors.
Don't set fractional font sizes (14px, 13.5px, 1.2rem) or rely on browser text zoom; cell geometry breaks and the box glyphs no longer meet.
Don't soften the voice with greetings, apologies, conversational fillers, emoji, or exclamation marks — the console states, it doesn't chat.
accessibility: Keep body text on the tested pairings (#a8a8a8 on #0000a8, #fcfcfc on #0000a8, #00d4d4 on #000000); #555555 and #005a5a are for large or non-essential text only, since they sit near the contrast floor against blue.

Never let inverse video be the only carrier of state: pair the swapped row with a textual marker such as `>` or `[ACTIVE]` and keep a real focus ring equivalent (a one-cell block or reverse band) that is visible at 16px.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: stop the cursor blink, print text instantly, and let the memory counter jump to its final value — the screen must remain readable with all steps() animation removed.

Keep all UI text at 16px or larger, ensure glyphs come from the monospace stack so CP437 frames don't shift, and provide an accessible name for glyph-only controls (the `X` close, `█` cursor, function-key numerals).
signatureElement: The POST memory count-up (0000 → N KB) plus the bottom function-key strip (1Help 2Menu … 10Quit)

prose.overview: This mode is the machine before the operating system: an Award BIOS POST screen, a DOS prompt, an IBM 3270 terminal session. Its surface is not a document but a grid of character cells, each one carrying a foreground attribute and a background attribute from a fixed 16-color hardware set. Everything the interface can say, it says by choosing which of those cells to set to which attribute — and every screen opens with chrome and closes with a function-key line.
prose.colors: The default field is Award BIOS blue #0000a8 with #a8a8a8 body text, #fcfc54 for values that need attention, #00a8a8 for informational labels, and #fc5454 for failure. Emphasis is structural, not chromatic: the same color pair inverted carries selection, hover, and active state, so a highlighted menu row is #0000aa on #a8a8a8 rather than a brighter blue. Nothing is blended — de-emphasis comes from the dark gray #555555 (or #005a5a in a 3270 session), and depth comes from black, never from a shadow gradient.
prose.typography: Type is the display itself, so the font is a 9x16 bitmap: Web437 IBM VGA 9x16 with Px437, Perfect DOS VGA 437, Fixedsys, and VT323 as fallbacks for CP437 coverage. Every size is an integer multiple of the 16px cell, one cell for labels, two for headings, three for a POST banner, and the container is scaled with transform:scale plus image-rendering:pixelated instead of fractional type. Case is load-bearing: headers and device names in UPPERCASE, typed input in lowercase, messages in sentence case.
prose.layout: Layout is a character grid, 80 columns by 25 rows at native size, with a header line at row 1 and an OIA or function-key line at row 80 of the last row. Content fills cells in whole units of the 4/8/16/24/32 spacing scale, and alignment is done with literal spaces and CP437 padding inside a <pre> rather than flexbox gaps. Two-column BIOS screens use a fixed label field (`Primary Master`), a colon, then the value field, so values stack in a clean vertical rule.
prose.elevation: There is no depth: no bevels, no inset highlights, no drop shadows on panels, and no z-axis implied by blur. A detached object can only be separated by the hard 10px 10px 0 #000000 offset or by moving it to the black field, exactly as a BIOS dialog floats as a black box over blue. The glow token, 0 0 4px currentColor, is reserved for phosphor-style emphasis on a single selected glyph, never for shadowing containers.
prose.shapes: Shapes are glyphs, not geometry, so the radius token is 0 and CSS borders are off the table. A frame is drawn with ╔ ═ ╗ ║ ╚ ╝ at line-height:1, a divider is ─ or │, and a menu group is bounded by double lines the way a 3270 field is. Buttons, inputs, and rows are rectangles of attribute color whose only edge is the end of the fill, and the block character █ is the sole oblong in the system.
prose.components: Panels are CP437 frames with reverse-video titles; buttons are two-cell-tall attribute rectangles whose trigger letter is red; inputs are dotted-leader label runs ending in an underscore field with a solid block caret; status and function-key strips run along the bottom in full inverse video. Menus are a reverse-video horizontal bar whose open dropdown is a double-line frame with one inverted row, and modal prompts appear as a black box with a ─ confirm line. Every component owns exactly two color attributes and swaps them for state.
prose.dosDonts: Do invert rather than tint, do use glyph frames instead of CSS borders, do keep the cursor and every transition on steps(), and do keep the header and function-key chrome on screen at all times. Don't add rounded corners or bevels, don't fade with opacity, don't set a 14px font, don't animate with ease-in-out, and don't soften system copy with greetings or emoji — the console reports, it never chats.
